meta.notes: Interface/suffix/game-type values from Tautellini doc (community) cross-checked with Questie_Forever.toc, Details_Camelot.toc, BigWigs and DBM TOCs listing 16001.
meta.talent_calc_note: Icy Veins calculator data 70959-a8fe1dab (current) is in research/talents_rogue.json. The 7 Icy Veins Rogue build links use 70755-6b631983 (Assassination and Combat pages, research/talents_rogue_70755-6b631983.json) and 70755-c04a9251 (Subtlety pages, research/talents_rogue_70755-c04a9251.json); tools/ivcalc.py maps them onto the current trees by talent name and all 7 decode to 51 valid points.

spells_by_level.name: Sinister Strike
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 8 ranks. Awards 1 combo point. Combat's builder (slow main hand). Efficient Strikes (Combat talent; Icy Veins still calls it Improved Sinister Strike) cuts its cost.
spells_by_level.flag: All rank levels and the 45 Energy cost come only from the endgametools client spell list (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Eviscerate
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 9 ranks. Damage per combo point, scales with Attack Power. Flawless Execution cuts its Energy cost (amount is a recorded conflict). wowfdb: only rank 6 is lower than Classic.
spells_by_level.flag: Levels after rank 1 come only from the endgametools client spell list (secondary); first rank cross-checked with wowfdb where noted. Rank 1 at level 1 also on wowfdb (utility page).

spells_by_level.name: Stealth
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 4 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 10 s cooldown. Speed penalty 50/40/35/30% by rank (endgametools tooltips). Master of Deception, Camouflage and Night Elf Quickness improve it.

spells_by_level.name: Redirect
spells_by_level.notes: New in Forever. 10 s cooldown, melee range. Removes your combo points from the target and stores them for up to 15 s; they go to the next non-player enemy you hit with a melee or ranged ability.
spells_by_level.flag: Only the endgametools client spell list shows Redirect (secondary); no other archived page mentions it.

spells_by_level.name: Pick Lock
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link and conquestcapped Wowhead link (1804); warcrafttavern links the Lockpicking skill as 1809
spells_by_level.notes: Learn level is a recorded conflict (client lists 1; Icy Veins milestone puts the Lockpicking class quest at 15; conquestcapped/warcrafttavern/kickegg say the trainer teaches it at 16). Lockpicking is its own secondary skill line (wowfdb); cap = level x 5; 5 s cast, 5 yd, needs Thieves' Tools (item 5060) in the bags (conquestcapped).

spells_by_level.name: Backstab
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 9 ranks (endgametools lists ranks 8 and 9 both at 60). 150% weapon damage plus a bonus; must be behind the target; dagger in the main hand. Puncturing Wounds adds crit and a chance for an extra combo point.
spells_by_level.flag: All rank levels and the 60 Energy cost come only from the endgametools client spell list (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Pick Pocket
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Needed (with Stealth) for every level-10 class quest that steals an item. wowfdb and endgametools agree on level 4.

spells_by_level.name: Gouge
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 5 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 10 s cooldown; 4 s incapacitate, target must face you, damage breaks it; awards 1 combo point. Improved Gouge (Assassination row 1) lengthens it.

spells_by_level.name: Evasion
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: +50% dodge for 15 s, 5 min cooldown. Endurance shortens the cooldown. Icy Veins: use it early and often while leveling.

spells_by_level.name: Sap
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Forever change: Sap no longer breaks Stealth (still needs Stealth; out-of-combat Humanoids; can't trigger weapon procs; sapping a PvP-flagged player flags you). Up to 25/35/45 s by rank. Dirty Tricks halves its cost; Quick Getaway allows 1 extra sapped target. Berserker Rage removes Sap (hotfix Nov 13).

spells_by_level.name: Slice and Dice
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 ranks: +20% then +30% melee attack speed, 9-21 s by combo points. Improved Slice and Dice extends it.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank 2 level (42) comes only from endgametools; rank 1 at 10 also on wowfdb.

spells_by_level.name: Sprint
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 3 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree): +50/60/70% speed for 15 s, 5 min cooldown, does not break stealth.

spells_by_level.name: Kick
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 4 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 10 s cooldown, locks the school for 5 s; 25 Energy (Icy Veins). Improved Kick adds a 2 s silence.

spells_by_level.name: Expose Armor
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Forever change: armor reduction matches 5 Sunder Armor applications at about the same level (2,250 at 5 combo points at max rank) and it no longer prevents Sunder Armor; Sunder does not overwrite it unless weaker. Improved Expose Armor now cuts the cost and refunds combo points at 5 points.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels after 14 come only from endgametools; rank 1 at 14 also on wowfdb.

spells_by_level.name: Garrote
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 6 ranks. Bleed from Stealth, behind the target (Dirty Deeds removes the facing requirement and cuts the cost). Icy Veins: the Subtlety opener once learned at 14; Ghostly Strike lets it work out of Stealth briefly.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels after 14 come only from endgametools; rank 1 at 14 also on wowfdb and Icy Veins Subtlety leveling.

spells_by_level.name: Feint
spells_by_level.notes: 5 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 10 s cooldown. Threat reduction: Blizzard says doubled, wowfdb client data shows about five times (recorded conflict).

spells_by_level.name: Ambush
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 6 ranks. 250% weapon damage plus a bonus; Stealth, behind the target, dagger in the main hand. Icy Veins Subtlety leveling milestone: Ambush unlock at 18. Ghostly Strike lets the next Ambush work out of Stealth.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels after 18 come only from endgametools; rank 1 at 18 on wowfdb and Icy Veins.

spells_by_level.name: Poised
spells_by_level.notes: New in Forever. While at maximum Energy and out of combat, your next ability costs 10 less Energy. Composure (Combat) adds to the discount.

spells_by_level.name: Rupture
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 6 ranks. Bleed finisher, 8-16 s by combo points. wowfdb: base damage cut by about 40% from Classic. Blood Splatter (+6 s), Serrated Blades (+30%) and Hemorrhage (+15% from the rogue) improve it.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels after 20 come only from endgametools; rank 1 at 20 also on wowfdb.

spells_by_level.name: Distract
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Forever change: affected enemies also have reduced Stealth detection for 10 s (as if 1 level lower), and enemy players are told a rogue is near. 30 s cooldown, 30 yd. Improved Distract was removed in the Nov 2 rework.

spells_by_level.name: Vanish
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 5 min cooldown; improved stealth for 10 s, breaks movement impairing effects. Costs 1 Flash Powder (item 5140, endgametools) unless the Legacy perk Reagent Economy is taken (wowfdb). Icy Veins milestone: Vanish unlock at 22.

spells_by_level.name: Shank
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: New in Forever. Off-hand strike for 50% weapon damage, generates 15 Energy (25 at rank 2), 10 s cooldown, cannot miss. Triggers Venom (Assassination); Boot Knife makes it add 2 combo points; Flash of Steel adds Energy and cuts the cooldown. Hotfix Nov 16: no longer removes combo points on other targets without Boot Knife. Icy Veins Subtlety leveling: learned at 24, use on cooldown.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank 2 level (44) and the rank-2 Energy gain come only from endgametools; level 24 is on wowfdb and Icy Veins.

spells_by_level.name: Detect Traps
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Passive. Needed for The Manor, Ravenholdt (Icy Veins class quests).

spells_by_level.name: Cheap Shot
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Stuns for 4 s from Stealth, awards 2 combo points. Icy Veins milestone: Cheap Shot unlock at 26. Dirty Deeds cuts the cost; Initiative adds a point.

spells_by_level.name: Disarm Trap
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 s cast, 5 yd; needs Thieves' Tools (endgametools tooltip).

spells_by_level.name: Kidney Shot
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 ranks: stun 1-5 s (rank 2: 2-6 s) by combo points, 20 s cooldown. Improved Kidney Shot makes stunned targets take 10% more damage from your attacks and poisons.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank 2 level (50) comes only from endgametools; rank 1 at 30 also on wowfdb.

spells_by_level.name: Blind
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 10 s disorient, 10 yd, 5 min cooldown; needs Blinding Powder (item 5530 per endgametools; made with the Poisons skill from 34 per wowfdb). Icy Veins milestone: Blind unlock at 34. Dirty Tricks halves the cost; Elusiveness shortens the cooldown.

spells_by_level.name: Safe Fall
spells_by_level.notes: Passive: reduces falling damage.

spells_by_level.name: Riposte (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Combat row 3, 1 point (10 points in Combat, reachable at 20). Usable after you parry: 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 s. Icy Veins: Riposte at 20 is a big leveling power spike; use it whenever it procs.

spells_by_level.name: Premeditation (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 3, 1 point (reachable at 20). Adds 2 combo points; use or add to them within 20 s.

spells_by_level.name: Cold Blood (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Assassination row 4, 1 point (16-point medal, reachable at 25). Next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate or Mutilate is a guaranteed crit. Icy Veins: pair it with a 5-point Eviscerate.

spells_by_level.name: Ghostly Strike (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 4, 1 point (16-point medal, reachable at 25). 125% weapon damage (180% with a main-hand dagger), +15% dodge for 7 s, and your next Ambush or Garrote within 7 s works without Stealth. Icy Veins: use on cooldown, follow with Garrote.

spells_by_level.name: Blade Flurry (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Combat row 5, 1 point (reachable at 30). +20% melee attack speed and melee attacks hit an extra nearby enemy for 15 s. Icy Veins milestone: Blade Flurry at 30.

spells_by_level.name: Hemorrhage (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 5, 1 point (reachable at 30; Icy Veins 'earliest possible Hemorrhage' at 30). 100% weapon damage (145% with a dagger), target takes 15% more Rupture and Garrote damage from you for 15 s, 1 combo point. Icy Veins: costs only 30 Energy; Subtlety's only builder once learned.

spells_by_level.name: Preparation (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 5, 1 point (reachable at 30). Finishes the cooldown of your other Rogue abilities (Icy Veins: not Shank).

spells_by_level.name: Venom (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins calculator data 70959 (rank spell id); Icy Veins guide pages link Venom as 1310703
spells_by_level.notes: Assassination row 5, 1 point (reachable at 30; Icy Veins milestone 'Venom available through talents' at 30). Passive: Shank raises your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 s. Replaced the deep dive's 31-point Venom finisher.

spells_by_level.name: Adrenaline Rush (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Combat row 7, 1 point (reachable at 40). +100% Energy regeneration for 15 s. Icy Veins milestone: Adrenaline Rush at 40.

spells_by_level.name: Mutilate (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Assassination row 7, 1 point (30 points in the tree, reachable at 40 per the talent data and Icy Veins milestones). Both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus a bonus, +20% against poisoned targets, 2 combo points; needs daggers in both hands. 60 Energy (Blizzard deep dive, endgametools). Ranks 2 and 3 at 50/60 from endgametools. Learn level is a recorded conflict.

spells_by_level.name: Death Mark (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 7 capstone, 1 point (reachable at 40), replaced Thousand Cuts. Finisher (a Curse) that marks the target and stores part of the damage your attacks deal per combo point (Garrote and Rupture at twice the rate); after 6 s the stored damage is dealt, up to a cap raised by Attack Power and crit. 25 Energy, 20 yd, 10 s cooldown (endgametools, wowfdb). Icy Veins: main finisher once learned.

spells_by_level.name: Poisons
spells_by_level.quest: Level-20 poison class quest (Alliance Mathias and the Defias / Klaven's Tower; Horde The Shattered Salute / Mission: Possible But Not Probable)
spells_by_level.notes: Poisons is its own secondary skill line with a spellbook tab (like First Aid); each poison rank is an item you make. Unlocked by the level-20 class quest (Icy Veins). wowfdb notes quest data teaching it at 24-26 (recorded conflict).

spells_by_level.name: Instant Poison
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 6 ranks; 30 min on a weapon; 20% chance per hit; charges 60/85/105/(1800 tooltip bug)/150/250. Base damage a third lower than Classic, attack-power coefficient 0.01 (wowfdb). Icy Veins: main hand.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels and charges come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Crippling Poison
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 ranks; 30% chance per hit, 50% (rank 2: 70%) slow for 12 s. Icy Veins: for mobs that run.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Mind-numbing Poison
spells_by_level.notes: 3 ranks; 20% chance per hit; casting time +40/50/60%; 75/115/225 charges.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Deadly Poison
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 5 ranks; 30% chance per hit, stacks 5 times; charges 90/115/135/240/240 in the wowfdb table (its note says 180 at rank V). Attack-power coefficient 0.009. Icy Veins: off hand, keep 5 stacks.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels and charges come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Wound Poison
spells_by_level.notes: 4 ranks; 30% chance per hit, stacks 5 times, reduces healing received. Mostly PvP.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Blinding Powder
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins Subtlety leveling link (6510)
spells_by_level.notes: Made with the Poisons skill from 34; reagent for Blind.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Gouge
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Remorseless Attacks
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Malice
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Ruthlessness
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Expose Armor
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Slice and Dice
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 45%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Vigor
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Increases your maximum Energy by 10. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Blood Splatter
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Increases the duration of your Rupture ability by 6 sec and your Garrote ability by 9 sec. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Lethality
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Vile Poisons
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Cold Blood
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Poisons
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Relentless Strikes
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 5, reachable at level 30. Max rank: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Venom
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 5, reachable at level 30. Max rank: Causes your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Kidney Shot
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 5, reachable at level 30. Max rank: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Seal Fate
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 6, reachable at level 35. Max rank: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Mutilate
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 7, reachable at level 40. Max rank: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Coup de Grace
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by 20%. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Efficient Strikes
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by 5. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Lightning Reflexes
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Puncturing Wounds
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Deflection
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Increases your Parry chance by 6%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Precision
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Improves your chance to hit by 3%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Sprint
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Endurance
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Riposte
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Composure
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Increases the Energy cost reduction of your Poised ability by 10. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Kick
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Flawless Execution
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 15. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Weapon Expertise
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Aggression
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by 15%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Dual Wield Specialization
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 5, reachable at level 30. Max rank: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Blade Flurry

Current medals by tree (Icy Veins calculator data 70959): Assassination - Blood Splatter (11th point, level 20), Cold Blood (16th, 25), Venom (21st, 30), Mutilate (31st, 40); Combat - Riposte (11th, 20), Flawless Execution (16th, 25), Blade Flurry (21st, 30), Adrenaline Rush (31st, 40); Subtlety - Premeditation (11th, 20), Ghostly Strike (16th, 25), Preparation and Hemorrhage (both 21st, 30), Death Mark (31st, 40).

talent_changes.change: Poisons: more charges on all poisons; can be applied together with temporary enchantments such as Weightstones and Sharpening Stones.
Distract also reduces affected enemies' Stealth detection for 10 s (and tells enemy players a rogue is near).
Expose Armor reduction raised to match 5 Sunder Armor applications at about the same level; it no longer prevents Sunder Armor, and Sunder does not overwrite it unless weaker.

Improved Gouge moved to Assassination row 1; Malice also covers Poisons; Improved Expose Armor redesigned (Energy cost cut, combo point refund at 5 points); Cold Blood moved to the 16-point medal and works with Mutilate; Improved Poisons adds a chance not to consume charges; Vigor became 2 points; Mutilate added as the 21-point medal (60 Energy, two daggers, 2 combo points); Seal Fate no longer needs Cold Blood and triggers once per Mutilate; Venom added as a 31-point 25-Energy finisher (+30% poison damage, +10% application).

Improved Eviscerate moved to row 1; Puncturing Wounds (was Improved Backstab) also crits Mutilate and can add a combo point; Deflection doubled; Precision covers spells and Poisons; Endurance is a percentage cut to Sprint and Evasion; Flawless Execution new 16-point medal (-10 Eviscerate Energy); Hack and Slash replaces Dagger/Mace/Sword/Fist Specialization and adds Axes; Weapon Expertise reduces dodge/parry; Aggression also boosts Backstab.

Camouflage, Setup, Initiative, Dirty Tricks (was Improved Sap; halves Sap/Blind cost), Improved Ambush, Ghostly Strike, Hemorrhage, Premeditation (16-point medal, 20 s), Serrated Blades, Dirty Deeds changed; new Improved Distract, Quietus, Cutthroat and Thousand Cuts (31-point). Sleight of Hand and Deadliness removed.

Venom became a passive row-5 talent that Shank triggers (+30% Poison damage, +20% Poison application, 6 s); Mutilate moved to row 7 (90% weapon damage); Blood Splatter added; Lethality 2 points; Relentless Strikes row 5, 5 points; Seal Fate 3 points; Improved Expose Armor row 2; Vigor row 3; Murder removed.

Improved Eviscerate became Coup de Grace (also boosts Death Mark); Improved Sinister Strike became Efficient Strikes; new Composure (Poised discount) and Flash of Steel (Shank Energy and cooldown); Flawless Execution now -15 Eviscerate Energy (was 10); Aggression row 4 (Sinister Strike and Eviscerate +5/10/15%); Dual Wield Specialization row 5, 2 points; Improved Sprint row 2; Weapon Expertise row 4.

Thousand Cuts replaced by Death Mark (row-7 finisher curse, capstone at 40); Quietus became Quick Getaway; new Boot Knife (Shank adds 2 combo points); Cutthroat and Improved Distract removed, Ghostly Strike now lets the next Ambush work without Stealth; Hemorrhage also raises Garrote damage; Premeditation row 3; Opportunity 5 points; Setup row 1 (15/30/45%); Dirty Deeds row 2; Camouflage 3 points; Elusiveness row 4; Heightened Senses row 5.
Instant Poison attack-power coefficient 0.005 -> 0.01; Deadly Poison 0.0045 -> 0.009; Slice and Dice no longer stands a sitting target up.
Rogue Poison ranks can no longer go above the maximum rank; Shank no longer removes your combo points on other targets when Boot Knife is not talented.
Mutilate (and Execute) no longer get an extra attempt to activate Windfury Totem; Nov 13: off-hand strikes such as Mutilate's do not activate Windfury, the main-hand strike still does.
Shank tooltip now shows Rank 1 and Rank 2; with Boot Knife it shows the combo points granted.

rotations.assassination: Icy Veins Assassination (Nov 4, 2026), a priority list: 1) maintain buffs and debuffs: Poisons on both weapons (Instant Poison main hand, Deadly Poison off hand, keep 5 Deadly stacks), Expose Armor if no stronger armor debuff is on the target, Slice and Dice always, Rupture if the target will live through it; 2) open from Stealth with Garrote; 3) Shank on cooldown to keep Venom up (not when Energy is nearly full); 4) Mutilate to build combo points; 5) at 5 combo points Eviscerate if Slice and Dice and Rupture are up and Shank is on cooldown. No AoE. Cooldowns: Cold Blood with a 5-point Eviscerate once threat is established; Vanish for mechanics, threat drop or a Garrote refresh. Leveling (Icy Veins, Nov 18): Instant Poison on both weapons (Crippling Poison for runners), open with Cheap Shot or Garrote, Backstab (Sinister Strike if you can't get behind; Mutilate from 40), Slice and Dice if more targets are coming else Eviscerate at 5 combo points.
rotations.combat: Icy Veins Combat (Nov 4, 2026): maintain Poisons (Instant Poison main hand, Deadly Poison off hand), Expose Armor if no stronger armor debuff, Slice and Dice always, Rupture if the target will live; open from Stealth with Garrote; Shank on cooldown if it won't overcap Energy; Sinister Strike to build (Backstab in the dagger variant); at 5 combo points Eviscerate if Slice and Dice and Rupture are up and Shank is on cooldown. Blade Flurry whenever a second target is in range (or on cooldown for its attack speed); Adrenaline Rush after the opening Energy is spent and threat is established; Cold Blood on a 5-point Eviscerate; Vanish for mechanics or a threat drop. Leveling (Icy Veins, Nov 18): Instant Poison on both weapons (Crippling Poison for runners), open with Cheap Shot or Garrote, Riposte whenever it procs, Sinister Strike to build, Slice and Dice if you are confident there will be targets for its duration, else Eviscerate at 5 combo points; Blade Flurry from 30 for two targets.
rotations.subtlety: Icy Veins Subtlety (Nov 4, 2026): pool Energy around Death Mark windows. 1) maintain: Instant Poison main hand, Deadly Poison off hand; Rupture (5 combo points), Death Mark (5 combo points), Garrote if the target will live, Slice and Dice (5 combo points); 2) cooldowns: Shank on cooldown at 0-3 combo points (Boot Knife adds 2), Ghostly Strike on cooldown followed by Garrote (Initiative makes it 2 combo points), Premeditation on cooldown; 3) builders: Ambush as the Stealth opener, Hemorrhage as the main builder (30 Energy). Hold Vanish and Preparation for dangerous moments. Don't use multi-point generators at 4 combo points; stand behind the boss. Leveling (Icy Veins, Nov 4): Garrote to open once learned (14), Backstab or Sinister Strike to build until Hemorrhage (30), then Hemorrhage only; Shank and Ghostly Strike on cooldown; Slice and Dice early, Rupture on durable targets from 30, Death Mark as the main finisher from 40 (sample opener: Garrote, Hemorrhage, Shank to 5 combo points, Death Mark, then Hemorrhage and Eviscerate).
rotations.energy: Energy regenerates continuously at about 10 per second (Icy Veins; wowfdb: no longer in 2-second ticks); never overcap it. Combo points stay on a target when you switch targets and are lost only when you start building on another enemy or the target dies (Icy Veins, wowfdb). Energy refunds: Shank (+15, +25 at rank 2, Flash of Steel more), Relentless Strikes, Adrenaline Rush; Poised cuts the next ability by 10 Energy when you start a fight at full Energy. Switching specs no longer refills Energy (wowfdb, Oct 16).
rotations.poisons: Poisons are learned through the level-20 class quest and are their own skill line; each poison is an item made with that skill and lasts 30 minutes on a weapon. Icy Veins: Instant Poison on the main hand and Deadly Poison on the off hand at endgame; Instant Poison on both weapons while leveling, Crippling Poison for enemies that run. Forever: more charges, poisons can crit (Malice) and use hit (Precision), and Blizzard says a poison can sit on a weapon together with a Sharpening Stone or Weightstone (client data did not show the stacking yet per wowfdb). Venom (via Shank) and Improved Poisons are the Assassination poison talents. Some mobs are immune to poisons (Icy Veins).

stat_priority.priority: Expertise (to 6.5%) > Hit (to 8%) > Agility > Weapon damage > Crit
stat_priority.notes: Icy Veins, last updated Nov 4, 2026. Melee ability hit cap vs a +3 boss is 8% (with 300 weapon skill); dual-wield auto-attack cap 27%. Two daggers are mandatory for Mutilate. Precision counts toward hit. Haste not evaluated. wowfdb's own list differs (dagger damage > hit > Agility > crit > Attack power > Stamina).

stat_priority.priority: Expertise (to 6.5%) > Hit (to 8%) > Agility > Weapon damage > Crit
stat_priority.notes: Icy Veins, last updated Nov 4, 2026. Same caps as Assassination (8% ability hit vs +3 boss, 27% dual-wield auto-attack). Expertise matters twice as much when you must attack from the front (parry). wowfdb: main-hand weapon damage > hit > Agility > crit > Strength > Stamina.

Icy Veins, last updated Nov 4, 2026: Weapon Damage > Expertise (to 6.5%) > Hit Chance (to 8%) > Weapon Skill > Agility. Weapon Skill (not a token here) sits between Hit and Agility; it reduces the glancing-blow penalty. Prefer slower weapons: '100 DPS 1.9 speed' loses to '90 DPS 2.8 speed'.

stat_priority.priority: Weapon damage > Hit > Expertise > Agility > Crit > Strength > Stamina
stat_priority.notes: Icy Veins Assassination and Combat leveling (Nov 18, 2026): Weapon Damage, then Hit & Expertise (rare while leveling, take them when you can), Agility, Critical Strike, Strength, Stamina. Combat wants a slow main hand (Sinister Strike, Riposte); Assassination two high top-end daggers. Subtlety leveling (Nov 4) puts raw Attack power between Agility and Crit ('if an item has more than twice as much AP as Agility/Strength, the AP item is likely better') and prefers slow weapons: '15 DPS 1.9 speed < 14 DPS 2.8 speed'.

race_notes.text: Forever Rogue races: Human, Dwarf, Gnome, Night Elf and High Order Skyborne (Alliance); Orc, Troll, Undead and Windshaper Skyborne (Horde) - every race except Tauren. Icy Veins (Nov 18): for Assassination and Combat, Undead (Touch of the Grave) is the best Horde race (Troll only wins against Beasts) and Gnome (Eureka!, Escape Artist) the best Alliance race. Subtlety: racial differences are very minor; Orc (Blood Fury) and Undead (slim edge) for Horde; Dwarf (+1% hit, Stoneform), Night Elf (burst racial, harder to detect) and Gnome (Escape Artist, Eureka!, +5% max Energy) for Alliance. Human Ruthless (+1% crit, no sword needed) is the Alliance Combat pick per wowfdb. Skyborne need the Skyborne Heroic Pack and start on Zephras Isle; Icy Veins says they get no level-10 class quest. Rip is a Human Rogue (Alliance): Ruthless crit; level-10 quest Seek out SI:7.

changes_log.change: Beta: Sap on a PvP-flagged target now flags the Rogue for PvP.

Beta: Blizzard announced Death Mark will replace Thousand Cuts; Shenthul (Orgrimmar) trains Windshaper Skyborne Rogues; a missed Expose Armor no longer costs combo points; Setup only adds points when your target is the enemy you dodged.

Blizzard Rogue and Warlock class deep dive: Sap keeps Stealth, Distract lowers detection, Expose Armor = 5 Sunders, Feint threat doubled, poisons with more charges stack with stones, one-handed axes, talent redesigns (Mutilate, Venom, Hack and Slash, Thousand Cuts).
Beta build 70291: several weapon swaps fit inside one global cooldown (swap macros can switch a whole set).

Beta: poisons no longer trigger against attackers; Sap can't trigger weapon procs; Cold Blood consumed when Mutilate crits; Human Sword Specialization replaced by Ruthless (+2% crit); Undead Touch of the Dead procs 20% for Rogues.
Beta: switching specializations no longer refills Energy.
Racials: Human Ruthless cut from 2% to 1% crit; Dwarf Artisan's Precision (+1% hit) replaces Earth Fury; Skyborne Wind Blessed 3% -> 2% haste.

Blizzard pre-launch notes (client 70755, datamined Nov 3): Shank (24) and Poised (18) added; talent rework (Venom passive via Shank, Mutilate row 7, Death Mark replaces Thousand Cuts, Coup de Grace, Efficient Strikes, Composure, Flash of Steel, Boot Knife, Quick Getaway, Blood Splatter; Murder, Cutthroat, Quietus, Improved Distract removed); Flawless Execution -15; poison AP coefficients doubled; training costs evened to 206-207 gold.
WoW Forever launch; wowfdb: Cutthroat removed, Ghostly Strike now lets the next Ambush work without Stealth; Death Mark is the Subtlety row-7 finisher.
Hotfix: Shank tooltip shows Rank 1 and Rank 2; with Boot Knife it shows the combo points granted.
Hotfix: restarting the Rogue quest 'Mission: Possible not Probable' works as intended.

Hotfix: Berserker Rage removes Sap; 'The Talisman of Kazdor' no longer sends rogues into the wrong version of Zul'Farrak; off-hand strikes (e.g. Mutilate's) don't activate Windfury Totem, main-hand strikes do.

Hotfix: Rogue Poison ranks can no longer exceed the maximum rank; Shank no longer removes combo points on other targets without Boot Knife; Mutilate no longer gets an extra Windfury Totem attempt; Witch Doctor Zum'rah spawns properly during 'The Talisman of Kazdor'.
Hotfix: various Paletusks can no longer be pickpocketed; a bin of mail in SI:7 lets Mathias Shaw give rogues the letter for 'The Manor, Ravenholdt'.

Verify in game at 15-16.

Blizzard deep dive (Oct 7): new 21-point gold medal talent (level 31). Current talent data (70959): row 7, 30 points required = level 40; Icy Veins Assassination leveling milestone and text: available at 40. The same Icy Veins page lists 'Massive Level 30 power spike with Mutilate' under Strengths. wowfdb: row 7 at level 40, but its Assassination leveling order spends it at 48 ('comes online at 48'; earlier at 30). endgametools lists Mutilate ranks 2 and 3 at 50 and 60.

Talent data and Icy Veins milestone: Venom is row 5 (20 points) = level 30. wowfdb's Assassination page says Venom 'from 45' / 'from 47' (its leveling order). Spell id: talent data rank id 1329328; Icy Veins guide pages link Venom as 1310703.

Blizzard deep dive (Oct 7) and wowguide: reduces Eviscerate's Energy cost by 10. wowfdb changes (Nov 3, client 70755) and the current Icy Veins calculator data (70959): by 15; wowfdb's own Eviscerate note on its Poisons & utility page still says 10.

Blizzard deep dive: Feint threat reduction doubled. wowfdb: the tooltip is unchanged but the hidden threat drop is about five times larger in game data (per rank 150->750, 240->1,200, 390->1,950, 600->3,000, 800->4,000).

Client lists Poisons at 20 and Icy Veins puts the poison class quest at 20; wowfdb notes the quest data has Klaven's Tower and Hinott's Assistance teaching it at 24-26 and asks whether it can be trained without the quest. Icy Veins Subtlety leveling recommends doing the quest at 22-23.

Icy Veins leveling gear for 51-60: not published (pages say the beta only reached level 30).
Gahz'rilla Fang (Assassination leveling, Zul'Farrak final boss): the page links spell 3742, not an item, so no item ID.

Defias Enforcer's Garb (5-piece rogue set, Alcaz Prison): Icy Veins gives no piece IDs or set bonuses. endgametools links some pieces (Chest 287020, Legguards 276746, Shoulderpads 276741, Prowlers 287021) without set bonuses.
Icy Veins leveling items have no stats on the page; slots not stated for Cartilage Shapers, Swine Fists, Embrace of the Lycan; source not stated for Spirit Hunter Headdress and Bloodsport Band.
Rogue enchants & consumables (Wowhead/Icy Veins pages not archived or not published): only the poison + stone stacking rule and leveling items are recorded.
Orc mount trainer/vendor: none of the sister repos cover Orc (Windshaper Skyborne uses the Skyborne row).

other_weapons.note: Rogues start with Daggers and Thrown; Combat leveling wants a slow, high top-end main hand for Sinister Strike/Riposte; Assassination must use two daggers for Mutilate; Subtlety cares about weapon speed and swaps between a dagger (Backstab/Ambush) and a slow weapon (Sinister Strike), Hemorrhage (30) works with either. Hack and Slash (Combat row 5) replaces the four weapon specializations and adds an axe bonus.

rules.rule: Use two Daggers: Mutilate needs a dagger in both hands. Look for a high top-end dagger; it is generally worth dropping some stats for higher weapon damage. Before upgrading, double check the weapon is a Dagger.
Main priority while leveling: a slow, high top-end main-hand weapon to maximise Riposte and Sinister Strike, then Agility and some Stamina.

Hack and Slash combines the removed Dagger, Mace, Sword and Fist Weapon Specializations and adds a bonus for Axes: axes get the sword benefit (chance of an extra attack); maces ignore some armor instead of a stun chance. Icy Veins: Bloodslash Axe helps take advantage of Hack and Slash.

Weapon speed matters: between a 15 DPS 1.9-speed weapon and a 14 DPS 2.8-speed weapon, the 2.8-speed one is better (many instant skills add a bonus on top of weapon damage). Avoid fast weapons such as Sword of Omen unless only in the off hand.

Backstab/Ambush need a dagger in the main hand; Icy Veins gives weapon-swap macros (dagger for Ambush, slow weapon for Sinister Strike; a swap costs a GCD and resets the swing timer). Hemorrhage (30) deals the same damage with daggers or slow weapons.
Stat page version of the rule: a 100 DPS 1.9-speed weapon loses to a 90 DPS 2.8-speed weapon.

professions.leveling: Skinning + Leatherworking (Icy Veins, all three rogue leveling pages: craft gear early that lasts many levels, likely some of the best end-game pieces too; Camp Tent gives 5% Rested XP, 1 h cooldown)
professions.raiding: Not published by Icy Veins for rogue. wowfdb (secondary) ranks Alchemy + Engineering for every rogue spec in PvE and Engineering + Alchemy in PvP.
alternatives: Herbalism + Alchemy - another great combination; Sap lets you herb without fighting, and you can herb inside dungeons, Vanish, leave and reset (Icy Veins Subtlety)
Engineering - for PvP: grenades and gadgets; Icy Veins suggests swapping Skinning for Engineering once you have crafted what you want (Icy Veins Subtlety)
Secondary: First Aid (bandage mid-combat after Blind/Gouge; now also crafts basic Healing Potions), Cooking (buff food, some raise XP gained)
professions.note: Rip has Skinning + Mining. Skinning is half of Icy Veins' main pick (it feeds Leatherworking), and Mining feeds Engineering (wowfdb names Mining as Engineering's partner; Engineering is Icy Veins' PvP pick). Keep both; show the recommendation, never tell him to drop them.

poison_rules.unlock_notes: Poisons and Thistle Tea are learned from this quest (Icy Veins). wowfdb: client lists Poisons at 20 but quest data has Klaven's Tower and Hinott's Assistance teaching it at 24-26 (open question). Icy Veins Subtlety leveling suggests coming back at 22-23 ("Poisons aren't all that strong early on"). Hotfix Nov 9: restarting "Mission: Possible not Probable" fixed. Quest IDs from conquestcapped Wowhead links.
poison_rules.stacks_with_temp_enchant_note: Announced by Blizzard (Weightstones and Sharpening Stones); wowfdb: client data does not show it yet; Windfury Totem interaction unconfirmed.
poison_rules.max_rank_hotfix_text: "Rogue Poison ranks can no longer go above the maximum rank." (Blizzard hotfixes, Nov 16)
poison_rules.duration_note: 30 minutes per weapon (wowfdb, client tooltips); Icy Veins Subtlety guide says 1-hr. See conflicts. You may randomly lose the buff when changing instances: carry spares (Icy Veins).
poison_rules.charges_note: Blizzard: charges increased on all poisons. wowfdb: every poison carries about 50% more charges than Classic (Instant I 60 vs 40, Deadly I 90 vs 60). Instant Poison IV tooltip "1800 charges" is a tooltip bug. Crippling lists no charges. Improved Poisons (Assassination) also gives a large chance for poisons not to consume charges (Blizzard deep dive).
poison_rules.ap_scaling_note: wowfdb utility: AP coefficients Instant 0.01, Deadly 0.009; wowfdb overview: "Announced, not in the client yet"; wowfdb changes: "Do poisons scale with attack power? A test found none." Poisons can crit (Malice, merged hit and crit). Unresolved: see conflicts.
poison_rules.vendor_note: After the quest you buy reagents from a Poison Vendor, usually close to your class trainers, and open the poison crafting interface (Icy Veins Subtlety guide). Reagent names and vendor NPCs: gap.
poison_rules.weapon_swap_note: Poisons sit on the weapon, so a weapon-swap macro lets you carry more than 2 poisons (Icy Veins).

suggested.why: Keep 5 stacks of Deadly Poison up while maximizing Instant Poison procs.
Keep 5 stacks of Deadly Poison up while maximizing Instant Poison procs.
Icy Veins Subtlety leveling: highest rank of Instant Poison on both weapons at all times.
Icy Veins Assassination leveling: ideally Instant Poison; consider Crippling Poison if mobs keep running away. Some mobs are immune to poisons.

tools.name: Thieves' Tools
tools.get: Free from the level-16 lockpicking class quest, or bought (about 15 silver, conquestcapped: Rogue supply vendors in Stormwind, Orgrimmar and the Riverglades; warcrafttavern: a Shady Dealer; kickegg: trade goods vendors). Only one set; must be in your bags.

lockpick_rules.learn: Pick Lock (spell 1804) from any Rogue trainer at level 16, free (conquestcapped, warcrafttavern). Client lists it at level 1 (wowfdb, kickegg); Icy Veins milestone puts the lockpicking class quest at 15. See core conflicts.
lockpick_rules.skill_line: Lockpicking is its own secondary skill line with a spellbook tab (wowfdb abilities/utility).
notes: Damage interrupts the 5 s cast. Skill points come only from the lock, not from looting; easy (grey) locks stop giving points.

Tooltip colour of "Locked": red = too low, orange = point every time, yellow = most of the time, green = rarely, grey = never (conquestcapped). In beta some grey footlockers still gave points: try once.

Footlockers/doors: right-click. Lockboxes in bags: cast Pick Lock and click the box. Other players' boxes: they put it in the bottom "Will not be traded" trade slot; you get the skill point, they keep the box (conquestcapped, kickegg, warcrafttavern).
Dark Leather Gloves (item 4248, Leatherworking) raise the skill a little (conquestcapped).
Divide the skill you need by five to get the level you need (conquestcapped).
Without Thieves' Tools in your bags the spell does nothing; the tools look like a crafting material, so check your bank if missing (conquestcapped).
Poison-quest chests: game data lists 70; players opened at 66 and failed at 55 (conquestcapped); Icy Veins class-quest guide says 75 is required. Get 80 (the cap at 16) before you go.

Lock values used are Classic: the Forever Wowhead DB shows a placeholder of 1 for every chest (conquestcapped); kickegg cross-checked the anchors against the 70862 client Lock table (48 lockpicking locks, 1-300).
Legacy perk Working Overtime raises skill-up chance for "primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill" by up to 20% (wowfdb legacy); whether Lockpicking counts is not stated.

Forever added level 19-20 Greater Tarantula spiders (npc 505) that respawn fast and whose eggs interrupt the cast: come with a friend, at level 20, or take the boat to Ratchet. Foreman Oslow (npc 341) in Lakeshire has a new spider quest "Alther's Mill" (quest 98386). Confirmed on live; points slow after 65; boxes work to about 100. Both factions can use either spot.

gold_tips.title: Pick every humanoid as you level
gold_tips.body: Every humanoid can carry a junkbox with coins, potions and sometimes a green. Open boxes yourself for skill and contents. Macro: #showtooltip Cheap Shot / /cast Pick Pocket / /cast Cheap Shot.

gold_tips.title: Pick Pocket + Sap macro
gold_tips.body: #showtooltip Pick Pocket / /cast Pick Pocket / /cast Sap - if a pick fails, the same key Saps the next mob.

gold_tips.title: Do not vendor unopened lockboxes
gold_tips.body: A vendor pays 50 copper to 5 silver for an unopened lockbox; open it. conquestcapped: boxes above your skill still sell on the AH to gamblers.

gold_tips.title: Junkboxes Needed
gold_tips.body: Fahrad (npc 6707) in Ravenholdt takes five Heavy Junkboxes for "Junkboxes Needed" (quest 8249) and pays a Dusksteel Throwing Knife (item 20086).

gold_tips.title: Faster respawns in seven zones
gold_tips.body: Since Oct 1: Hillsbrad Foothills, Ashenvale, Wetlands, Duskwood, Thousand Needles; Stonetalon Mountains and Redridge Mountains earlier. More humanoids to pick per hour.

gold_tips.title: Auction House deposit
gold_tips.body: wowcamp (Nov 6): every listing costs at least 1 silver deposit, lost if unsold, so vendor sub-silver items. kickegg news ticker (Nov 19): deposit floor dropped from 1 silver to 1 copper (Wowhead report).

gold_tips.title: GoldScout logs pickpockets
gold_tips.body: GoldScout (CurseForge project 1790110) records pickpocket and kill loot in WoW Forever only; the Companion app uploads it and pulls AH prices hourly. Confidence labels: low <5, fair 5-14, good 15-49, high 50+ (per kill or pickpocket). Rows here carry sample_n.

gold_tips.title: Rogue gold by level (wowcamp table)
gold_tips.body: 20: Durnholde, Redridge. 30: the Syndicate in Alterac and Arathi. 40: Tanaris. 60: Burning Steppes, dungeons. Why: pockets, junkboxes and lockboxes.

gold_tips.title: Professions
gold_tips.body: Icy Veins Subtlety leveling: Herbalism + Alchemy (Sap to herb, dungeon herb resets); Engineering for PvP (switch from Skinning later); always First Aid. wowfdb professions page recommends Alchemy and Engineering for Rogue.

legacy_perks.name: Reagent Economy
legacy_perks.what: Your class abilities no longer require reagents purchaseable from vendors. 1 rank, column 3 of the Resourcefulness tree (needs 10 points spent there first, so at least 11 points).
legacy_perks.rogue_note: Removes the Flash Powder cost of Vanish (wowfdb abilities). Blinding Powder is crafted (Poisons skill), so whether Blind still needs it is not stated. Hotfix Nov 17: "Reagent Economy should no longer randomly stop working."

legacy_perks.name: Working Overtime
legacy_perks.what: +20% chance (4% per rank, 5 ranks) to gain a skill increase from any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill.
legacy_perks.rogue_note: Lockpicking and Poisons are their own skill lines (wowfdb); whether they count as class-based tradeskills here is not stated.

legacy_perks.name: Bartering
legacy_perks.what: Vendors sell to you 5/10% cheaper (2 ranks, column 2 Professions); no longer discounts training or repairs.
legacy_perks.rogue_note: Applies to vendor reagents such as Flash Powder and poison reagents.

legacy_perks.name: High Alert
legacy_perks.what: Detect Stealth as if 2 levels higher (2 ranks, column 2 Adventure). Ineffective in battlegrounds.
legacy_perks.rogue_note: Enemy players can take this against you in world PvP; it does nothing in battlegrounds.

legacy_perks.name: Thrill of Adventure
legacy_perks.what: 5% max Health and Mana over 10 sec on a killing blow against a non-trivial enemy (5 ranks). Not in dungeons, raids, battlegrounds.
legacy_perks.rogue_note: Icy Veins Subtlety leveling recommends it (rogues have no self-heal).

legacy_perks.name: Well Rested
legacy_perks.what: Rested XP accumulates 20% faster and the cap is 20% higher (5 ranks).
legacy_perks.rogue_note: Icy Veins Subtlety leveling recommends it for slower players.

legacy_perks.name: Talented
legacy_perks.what: Talent points every level from level 9 (choice down to 5) instead of 10; still max 51. Column 2 Adventure.
legacy_perks.rogue_note: Icy Veins: earlier access to Hemorrhage or Death Mark; needs 5 points in Well Rested first.

legacy_perks.name: Field Medicine
legacy_perks.what: Recently Bandaged 10 sec shorter (2 ranks). Not in dungeons, raids, battlegrounds.
legacy_perks.rogue_note: Rogues lean on bandages for healing.

legacy_perks.name: Bountiful Harvest
legacy_perks.what: Up to 100% more likely to find Scarce materials from Mining, Herbalism and Skinning (5 ranks).

legacy_perks.name: Legacy point rules
legacy_perks.what: Points are earned once per account from 65 challenges; each character spends up to 16; a class trainer resets them. Columns open at 5 and 10 points spent in a tree; only one column-3 perk fits on a character.
legacy_perks.rogue_note: Reagent Economy (column 3) uses 11 of the 16 points.

stealth_notes.title: Sap no longer breaks Stealth
stealth_notes.body: Using Sap no longer breaks Stealth (still requires Stealth, out-of-combat Humanoids, 65 energy per wowfdb). Sap one mob and open on another while hidden. Sap cannot trigger weapon procs (wowfdb). Talent Quick Getaway lets you Sap 1 more target (wowfdb).

stealth_notes.title: Distract lowers stealth detection
stealth_notes.body: Distract now also reduces affected enemies' Stealth detection for 10 seconds (wowfdb: as if 1 level lower). The debuff tells enemy players a rogue is nearby. Improved Distract was removed in the Nov 2 rework (wowfdb, warcraftmaps).

stealth_notes.title: Master of Deception and Camouflage
stealth_notes.body: Master of Deception reduced from 5 to 3 points for the same effect; Camouflage moved to row 1 (Blizzard). warcraftmaps: Stealth at rank 60 costs 30% speed and Camouflage takes 15% off that. Icy Veins: Master of Deception rank 3 is almost required to pickpocket the Horn of Xelthos NPCs at level 20.

stealth_notes.title: Eye above the head = stealth detection
stealth_notes.body: Enemies with an Eye above their heads have Stealth detection and see you from further away in Stealth than out of it; sometimes it is better to walk past unstealthed.

stealth_notes.title: Sprint does not break Stealth
stealth_notes.body: If you get seen, Sprint does not break Stealth, so use it early to get past (warcraftmaps BRD lap). wowfdb: Sprint "Does not break stealth".

stealth_notes.title: Bloodhounds see through stealth
stealth_notes.body: In Blackrock Depths the Bloodhound (npc 8921) sees through stealth; dogs have no pockets and end most pickpocket laps (warcraftmaps).

stealth_notes.title: Pick each mob once
stealth_notes.body: A pocket holds one roll, so a second Pick Pocket only gives the mob a chance to spot you. If a pick fails the target turns on you: keep Sap on the same key for the next mob.

stealth_notes.title: Pockets refill
stealth_notes.body: Pickpocketed mobs refill their pockets after about 10 minutes (kickegg); conquestcapped says "after a few minutes"; in an instance, pockets stay empty until you reset (warcraftmaps). Unverified: measure in game.

stealth_notes.title: Paletusks cannot be pickpocketed
stealth_notes.body: Hotfix Nov 17: "Various Paletusks can no longer be pickpocketed".

stealth_notes.title: Premeditation and Ghostly Strike open out of Stealth
stealth_notes.body: Premeditation no longer needs Stealth (points last 20 sec); Ghostly Strike lets your next Ambush work without Stealth.

stealth_notes.title: High Alert legacy perk
stealth_notes.body: Players with High Alert detect Stealth as if 2 levels higher (not in battlegrounds).

stealth_notes.title: Vanish does not drop combat in PvE
stealth_notes.body: Vanish lets you escape or channel a bandage, but it will not drop combat in PvE; in PvP it can give a quick re-stealth.

summary.text: PvP is live since the Nov 4, 2026 launch (season 1). Progression has two tracks: Honor (currency) and Rank Points (14 ranks, weekly cap). Honor buys a blue set; the epic set = blue piece + rank-gated Emboldened Seal. Four battlegrounds at launch (Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, Darkspear Islands, Alterac Valley); no arenas or rated PvP announced. Battlegrounds mix all rulesets except Hardcore, but there is no cross-ruleset or cross-faction grouping. Your rank, Rank Points and buyable rewards are on Character pane (C) > Player vs. Player tab.

rulesets.name: Normal
rulesets.notes: Fight other players at your own discretion. Both factions allowed on the account.

rulesets.name: PvP
rulesets.notes: Almost always at risk of being attacked by the other faction. Only one faction per account on this ruleset; faction-balance systems (Season of Discovery style creation limits).

rulesets.name: Roleplay
rulesets.notes: Strict naming and behaviour rules. Both factions allowed.

rulesets.name: Roleplay PvP
rulesets.notes: Roleplay rules plus open-world PvP (almost always at risk). Blizzard post does not state its faction limit.

rulesets.name: Hardcore
rulesets.notes: After launch; fully separate ecosystem, not in shared battlegrounds; a dead Hardcore character can transfer to another ruleset incl. PvP.

honor.cap_note: Honor cap raised from 15,000 to 25,000 in the Oct 1 beta build (Blizzard dev notes); gear/token Honor costs +~50% in the same build. Live cap not restated since launch.

Beta data (lfcarry, thetirisfalen): Rank 14 = 24,750 Rank Points, earliest in season week 10 - unconfirmed.

gear_path.text: Honor buys two PvP sets: blue (rare) and epic. Epic = matching blue piece + Emboldened Seal; seals have rank requirements. New/reworked sets fill missing specs. Earning a rank does not award the item - buy the blue piece, reach the rank, buy the seal, upgrade.
gear_path.emboldened_seal: Rank-gated upgrade item per slot (R8 bracers/belt, R9 boots, R10 gloves, R12 legs/shoulders, R13 chest/helm); weapons are R14 rewards.

battlegrounds.name: Warsong Gulch
battlegrounds.objective: Capture the enemy flag 3 times (Classic's rules; Blizzard has not restated them).
battlegrounds.alliance_queue: Battlemaster in any capital city (Stormwind Keep per Icy Veins via loreforever); no remote queue.
battlegrounds.marks: Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor (item 20558, foreverdb) for reputation quests; marks stack to 30 (Blizzard, Oct 16 notes). Icy Veins (via loreforever): 3 marks per win, 1 per loss - unconfirmed.
battlegrounds.vendor_note: Battleground faction sells gear/consumables as reputation rises (foreverdb); Alliance faction name not on any archived page.
battlegrounds.call_to_arms: Holiday week: highlighted battleground gives extra Honor and Rank Points (Blizzard); foreverdb names it 'Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch'.
battlegrounds.notes: Nov 9 hotfix removed an invisible wall blocking the roof of the Alliance base. First queue at level 10.
battlegrounds.flag: Size/levels from the launch client and rules from Classic via foreverdb (secondary); Blizzard has not published WSG details

battlegrounds.marks: Arathi Basin Mark of Honor (item 20559, foreverdb) for reputation quests; marks stack to 30 (Blizzard).

battlegrounds.name: Darkspear Islands
battlegrounds.objective: Capture point + flag map off the shores of Dustwallow Marsh: hold four capture points (more held = faster points); carry the central flag to a base your team controls for extra points; first team to 2000 points wins.
battlegrounds.alliance_queue: Battlemaster in any major capital city, or the Theramore Expeditionary Force base at Northwatch (The Barrens), whose portal takes you into the battle.
battlegrounds.portal: Northwatch, The Barrens (Theramore Expeditionary Force base)
battlegrounds.marks: Turn in Marks of Honor on reputation quests; Darkspear Islands Mark of Honor = item 274895 (foreverdb, unconfirmed). Marks stack to 30 (Blizzard).
battlegrounds.vendor_note: Base vendors sell gear and consumables (trinkets, rings, cloaks, weapons, armor pieces) at reputation thresholds; battleground quests at the base; Exalted unlocks a short questline for the faction's exclusive tabard.
battlegrounds.call_to_arms: Holiday week: extra Honor and Rank Points (Blizzard); foreverdb: 'Call to Arms: Darkspear Islands'.
battlegrounds.horde_note: Horde side: Darkspear Raiders, base and portal at the Merchant Coast (The Barrens).
battlegrounds.notes: Nov 2 notes: dropping the flag no longer gives the dropper a 'Recently Dropped Flag' debuff.

queue.text: Queue at a battlemaster: Blizzard says every major capital city has one (Darkspear post); secondary pages name Stormwind Keep (and Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar, Horde). Darkspear Islands also via the Northwatch portal. No remote queue button (players asked Oct 7, no reply); players report being returned to where they accepted the queue. Battlegrounds mix rulesets (not Hardcore) but you cannot queue as a group with a friend on another ruleset.
queue.flag: remote_queue=false and Stormwind Keep from wowforevertierlist/loreforever (secondary); Blizzard only says 'battlemaster in any major capital city'

call_to_arms.text: Each battleground has holiday weeks: the highlighted battleground gives increased Honor and an additional Rank Point boost. foreverdb (client) calls them Call to Arms weeks for Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, Darkspear Islands and Alterac Valley; schedule not published.

seasonal.text: PvP runs in seasons. Each season has a journey of weekly tasks granting Honor and Rank Points; three tasks per season also grant a Legacy Point and stay completable in later seasons. Legacy PvP challenges (12 points): reach ranks 3, 7, 10, 13 and 14 (5), Exalted with each battleground reputation (4), and the week 4, 7 and 10 quests of the 'Field of Honor' season journey (3). Legacy perk 'For Great Honor' (Resourcefulness tree) increases Honor gains. First PvP season refresh: spring 2027 (roadmap), second: summer 2027 (lfcarry).

limits.why: COMBAT_LOG_EVENT is removed and Combat Log chat-tab text is a string type addons cannot parse - no kill-blow credit, enemy cooldown/trinket tracking, DR tracking or log-based enemy detection.

Other units' health %/missing (UnitHealthPercent/UnitHealthMissing), power %/missing, primary resources and casts are Secret: addon code can pass them to bars/cooldown widgets but not compare them - e.g. an execute-range 'target under 35%' check cannot be computed.
Aura lists and UNIT_AURA still fire, but aura contents are Secret; helper functions (instance IDs, has-expiration, counts, dispel colours) remain.

In instances chat reaches addons as Secrets and addons may not send any chat or addon messages; creature names/GUIDs/IDs are Secret. Blizzard does not say whether battlegrounds count - assume yes: no BG callouts or addon sync.
limits.flag: Midnight documentation Forever inherits; not Forever-tested; BG applicability unknown

limits.what: Secure code out of combat only
limits.why: Secure snippets (bar paging, click-casting) run out of combat; one press = one action.
Blizzard's stated aim: addons should not automate combat decisions; named targets include relabelling enemies by role ('Healer'), renaming casts, and colouring nameplates by priority.
The only Forever statement is a Blizzard rep in the WoW UI Discord (Sep 15, 2026) that Midnight's disarmament, incl. secrets, is active; nothing has been publicly tested at 60 on a Forever build.

Built-in; off by default, enable in Options > Gameplay Enhancement (Blizzard dev notes); /cdm picks spells (foreverbase, hearthproof). Supports all classes, racials and trinkets (Oct 8 notes); all ranks = one entry (Oct 15); shows CC duration with DR (Nov 6 hotfix); Seals shown correctly since Nov 9 hotfix. Gaps: no Healthstone, pet cooldowns, weapon enhancements; consumables later.

Built-in swing timer: C_SwingTimer namespace, PLAYER_SWING event and a visibility setting that defaults to off (from client data). Nov 4 notes: Swing Timer bar no longer fades by distance until the swing finishes.

Runtime tests for Secret values/objects (Midnight documentation Forever inherits). Comparing possibly-Secret values of different types returns false instead of erroring; 'if x then' still works as a nil test.
The player's own casts and those of units the player controls stay readable in combat; other units' casts are Secret.
Readable for player units; UnitHealthPercent/UnitHealthMissing/UnitPowerPercent/UnitPowerMissing return Secrets.
Build 70170 added WOW_PROJECT_CAMELOT = 18; select(4, GetBuildInfo()) > 16000 and < 20000 identifies Forever. hearthproof says the client reports WOW_PROJECT_ID 1 (see conflicts).
Blizzard ships settings that force instance chat lockdown (not persisting across restart) and Secret auras/cooldowns/unit identity/spellcasts, for testing out of instances. Setting names not given.

rogue_notes.title: Sap flags you
rogue_notes.body: Sapping a PvP-flagged player flags the Rogue (since Sep 24 per wowfdb changes).

rogue_notes.title: Distract warns players
rogue_notes.body: Distract lowers enemies' Stealth detection for 10 s, but the debuff tells enemy players a rogue is nearby.

rogue_notes.title: Berserker Rage removes Sap
rogue_notes.body: Nov 13 hotfix (Warrior): fixed Berserker Rage not removing Sap - warriors can break your Sap.

rogue_notes.title: Diminishing returns
rogue_notes.body: Client data sorts CC into Classic DR families: incapacitates (Sap, Gouge, Polymorph, Freezing Trap...), controlled stuns, Kidney Shot alone, Distract its own family. Forever durations unannounced; whether the server applies Sap's family is unknown. Classic: each repeat within 15 s half as long, 4th immune.

rogue_notes.title: Crits do full damage
rogue_notes.body: The PvP crit reduction is gone; no resilience or PvP damage modifier announced.

rogue_notes.title: Sap and weapon procs
rogue_notes.body: Sap does not trigger weapon procs; Discolored Healing Potion damage no longer breaks CC.

rogue_notes.title: Weapon skill in battlegrounds
rogue_notes.body: In battlegrounds your weapon skill counts as level x 5; it still matters in world PvP and duels.

rogue_notes.title: Engineering for PvP
rogue_notes.body: Icy Veins: Engineering adds grenades and gadgets to your control kit; consider switching Skinning to Engineering at max level. wowfdb: Net-o-Matic roots up to 30 yd (10 min cooldown); grenades and bombs share a 1 min cooldown.

rogue_notes.title: Free Action / Limited Invulnerability Potions
rogue_notes.body: Free Action Potion: immune to stuns and movement impairing for 30 s but does not remove one already on you. Limited Invulnerability Potion: immune to physical attacks for 6 s (a hard counter to your burst). Both Alchemy.

rogue_notes.title: High Alert
rogue_notes.body: Legacy perk: enemies detect Stealth as if 2 levels higher; ineffective in battlegrounds, so a world-PvP threat.

rogue_notes.title: Subtlety PvP burst
rogue_notes.body: Icy Veins expects Subtlety to be a menace in PvP: Sap two targets (Quick Getaway), heavy bleeds, Cold Blood + Hemorrhage into a guaranteed-crit Eviscerate before Cheap Shot ends.

rogue_notes.title: Racials for PvP
rogue_notes.body: Orc: stun duration reduction; Undead: Fear/Charm break; Night Elf: harder to detect; Gnome: underrated, escapes roots and snares (Icy Veins Subtlety).

rogue_notes.title: Wound Poison is stronger
rogue_notes.body: Wound Poison reduces healing by 67 per stack at rank 1 up to 165 at rank IV (Classic 135), 5 stacks; "mostly PvP".

rogue_notes.title: Unknowns
rogue_notes.body: Rank 2 PvP trinket effect/cooldown, rank 5 combat potions, PvP set bonuses and DR durations are not announced.

poison_choices.when: Against healers and self-healers: up to -165 healing per stack (rank IV), 5 stacks, 30% per hit. "Mostly PvP".
To stick to or escape a target: 50% slow (70% at rank II) for 12 s at 30% per hit; your only slow.
Against casters: 40-60% slower casting; "useful on caster packs and in PvP".
Default damage setup (Icy Veins PvE advice; no PvP-specific source).
